sentences.en: New York Times best-selling author, John Green, is making a positive impact on a new generation through his books, educational videos, blogs, and social media.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》畅销书作家约翰·格林通过他的书籍、教育视频、博客和社交媒体对新一代产生积极影响。

sentences.en: While John's books have been written primarily for a young adult audience, they have been appreciated by young and old alike and now been published in more than a dozen languages.
sentences.zh: 虽然约翰的书主要是为年轻的成年读者写的，但它们受到了年轻人和老年人的一致赞赏，现在已经以十几种语言出版。

sentences.en: His latest novel, The Fault in Our Stars, was Time Magazine's #1 fiction book of the year in 2012 and will soon be made into a film by 20th Century Fox.
sentences.zh: 他的最新小说《星运里的错》荣获《时代》杂志 2012 年年度小说第一名，并将很快由 20 世纪福克斯公司拍成电影。

sentences.en: John's other best-selling books include Looking for Alaska, An Abundance of Katherines and Paper Towns.
sentences.zh: 约翰的其他畅销书包括《寻找阿拉斯加》、《凯瑟琳的丰富》和《纸镇》。

sentences.en: He was a 2006 recipient of the Michael L. Printz Award, the 2009 Edgar Award and has twice been a finalist for the Los Angeles Times Book Prize.
sentences.zh: 他是 2006 年迈克尔·L·普林茨奖、2009 年埃德加奖的获得者，并两次入围洛杉矶时报图书奖的决赛。

sentences.en: In addition to his literary success, John and his brother, Hank, have become cultural icons through Vlogbrothers, an exchange of YouTube video blogs between the two of them since 2007.
sentences.zh: 除了文学上的成功之外，约翰和他的兄弟汉克还通过 Vlogbrothers（自 2007 年以来两人之间的 YouTube 视频博客交流）成为了文化偶像。

sentences.en: The Vlogbrothers channel has received over 300 million views and has created a worldwide community of people called Nerdfighters (any out there?) who celebrate intellectualism,
sentences.zh: Vlogbrothers 频道已获得超过 3 亿次观看，并创建了一个名为 Nerdfighters（那里有吗？）的全球社区，他们崇尚理智主义，

sentences.en: empathy for others, and social justice. John and Hank have also recently started offering open online education through a YouTube channel called CrashCourse.
sentences.zh: 对他人的同情和社会正义。约翰和汉克最近还开始通过 YouTube 频道 CrashCourse 提供开放的在线教育。

sentences.en: Hank teaches science while John teaches literature, US history, and world history.
sentences.zh: 汉克教授科学，约翰教授文学、美国历史和世界历史。

sentences.en: John performed An Evening of Awesome to a sold out crowd in Carnegie Hall in January 2013 and appeared on the Late Show with Craig Ferguson in March 2013.
sentences.zh: 2013 年 1 月，约翰在卡内基音乐厅向座无虚席的观众表演了《An Evening of Awesome》，并于 2013 年 3 月出现在《Craig Ferguson 深夜秀》中。

sentences.en: While John's professional success has been nothing short of astronomical, more importantly he is committing to using his success to making the world a better place.
sentences.zh: 虽然约翰的职业成功堪称天文数字，但更重要的是，他致力于利用自己的成功让世界变得更美好。

sentences.en: He truly represents the ideals of Butler University.
sentences.zh: 他真正代表了巴特勒大学的理想。

sentences.en: John is an alumnus of Kenyon College, where he earned his Bachelor of Arts degree with a double major in English and Religious Studies.
sentences.zh: 约翰是凯尼恩学院的校友，他在那里获得了英语和宗教研究双学位的文学学士学位。

sentences.en: John, will you please come forward? On the recommendation of the faculty, with the approval of the Butler University Board
sentences.zh: 约翰，请你站出来好吗？根据教师的推荐，并经巴特勒大学董事会批准

sentences.en: of Trustees and by the authority invested in me, I confer upon you, John Green, the degree of Doctor of Letters honoris causa, with all the rights, privileges and responsibilities
sentences.zh: 受托人的委托，并根据我的授权，我授予你约翰·格林荣誉文学博士学位，并赋予你所有的权利、特权和责任

sentences.en: thereto. Good morning. It's going to take me a minute to unfold this.
sentences.zh: 至此。早上好。我需要花一点时间来展开这个过程。

sentences.en: Thank you President Danko. Those are the first words of my speech.
sentences.zh: 谢谢丹科总统。这是我演讲的第一句话。

sentences.en: My own commencement speaker, who shall remain nameless, began his speech with a lame joke about how these gigs only come in two varieties: Short and bad.
sentences.zh: 我自己的毕业典礼演讲者（他将保持匿名）以一个蹩脚的笑话开始他的演讲，说这些演出只有两种：短的和糟糕的。

sentences.en: This raised my expectations tremendously, and then he went onto speak for 26 minutes, so I'm just going to tell you right now: 12 minutes flat, 11:45 if you don't laugh.
sentences.zh: 这极大地提高了我的期望，然后他继续讲了 26 分钟，所以我现在就告诉你：12 分钟，如果你不笑的话，11 点 45 分。

sentences.en: I do want to congratulate everyone who's here today and I do mean everyone—parents, families, friends, professors, coaches.
sentences.zh: 我确实想祝贺今天在场的每一个人，我指的是每一个人——父母、家人、朋友、教授、教练。

sentences.en: Every single person in Hinkle today has given something to make this moment possible for the class of 2013—well, except for me, but everyone else has.
sentences.zh: 今天欣克尔的每一个人都付出了一些努力，让 2013 届毕业生的这一时刻成为可能——好吧，除了我，但其他人都做了。

sentences.en: But special congratulations to you graduates today.
sentences.zh: 但要特别祝贺你们今天的毕业生。

sentences.en: Before we get to the Life Advice You'll Soon Forget portion of the program, I want to engage in a time-honored tradition of American commencement addresses: Stealing from other commencement addresses, in this case one by the children's television host Mr. Fred Rogers.
sentences.zh: 在我们开始节目的“你很快就会忘记的生活建议”部分之前，我想先讲一下美国毕业典礼演讲的一项历史悠久的传统：窃取其他毕业典礼演讲的内容，在本例中是儿童电视节目主持人弗雷德·罗杰斯先生的演讲。

sentences.en: I want you to spend one minute, which I know is an eternity in the age of the internet, but I want you to spend one minute, if you will, thinking of some of the people who helped get you to today, the people who loved you and without whose care and generosity you
sentences.zh: 我希望你能花一分钟，我知道这在互联网时代是永恒的，但我希望你能花一分钟，如果你愿意的话，想想那些帮助你走到今天的人，那些爱你的人，如果没有他们的关心和慷慨，你

sentences.en: might not have found yourself here, graduating from Butler, or watching someone you love graduate, or seeing your students graduate.
sentences.zh: 你可能没有发现自己在这里，从巴特勒大学毕业，或者看着你爱的人毕业，或者看到你的学生毕业。

sentences.en: Think for one minute of those who have loved us up into this day.
sentences.zh: 想一想那些至今仍爱着我们的人。

sentences.en: I'll keep the time.
sentences.zh: 我会保留时间。

sentences.en: (1 minute of silence)
sentences.zh: （默哀1分钟）

sentences.en: Those people are so proud of you today. I want to return to them soon, but first I have to deliver terrible news, which is that you are all going to die.
sentences.zh: 今天，那些人为你感到骄傲。我想尽快回到他们身边，但首先我必须传达一个可怕的消息，那就是你们都会死。

sentences.en: This is another time-honored tradition of American celebration, the Raining on the Parade.
sentences.zh: 这是美国庆祝活动的另一个历史悠久的传统，“下雨游行”。

sentences.en: I remember when I got married, the priest devoted the majority of his homily to telling me how challenging and laborious and often miserable marriage would be, and I kept thinking,
sentences.zh: 我记得当我结婚时，神父在讲道中用大部分时间告诉我，婚姻将是多么具有挑战性、多么辛苦，而且往往是多么悲惨，我一直在想，

sentences.en: "That seems like something that could wait for TOMORROW."
sentences.zh: “这似乎可以等到明天。”

sentences.en: But no, it can't. You are going to die. Not only that.
sentences.zh: 但不，不能。你快要死了。不仅如此。

sentences.en: It gets worse. Everything you ever make and think and experience will be washed away by the sands of time.
sentences.zh: 情况变得更糟。你曾经做过、思考过、经历过的一切都会被时间的沙子冲走。

sentences.en: The Sun will blow up and no one will remember Cleopatra ruling Egypt or Crick and Watson untangling the structure of DNA or Ptolemy fathoming the stars or even that improbably
sentences.zh: 太阳会爆炸，没有人会记得克利奥帕特拉统治埃及，或者克里克和沃森解开DNA的结构，或者托勒密探索星星，甚至那些不可思议的事情

sentences.en: wonderful game against Gonzaga. So that's unfortunate.
sentences.zh: 对阵冈萨加的精彩比赛。所以这很不幸。

sentences.en: But I would argue that it's good to be aware of temporariness on a day like today when you are thinking about what you want to do with your life.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，在像今天这样的日子里，当你思考自己想做什么时，意识到暂时性是件好事。

sentences.en: The whole idea of this commencement speech is that I'm supposed to offer you some thoughts on how you might live a good life out there in the so-called Real World, which by the way I assure you is no more or less real than the one in which you have so far found yourselves.
sentences.zh: 这篇毕业典礼演讲的整个想法是，我应该向你们提供一些关于如何在所谓的现实世界中过上美好生活的想法，顺便说一句，我向你们保证，这个世界并不比你们目前所处的现实世界更真实或更不真实。

sentences.en: But I can't give any advice about how to live a good life unless and until we establish what constitutes a good life.
sentences.zh: 但我无法就如何过上美好的生活给出任何建议，除非我们确定什么是美好的生活。

sentences.en: Of course, that's much of what you've been up to for the past four or five years or six, whether you've been studying Dance or Literature, and I'm not going to swoop in here at the end with any interesting revelations.
sentences.zh: 当然，这就是你过去四年、五年或六年所做的大部分事情，无论你是学习舞蹈还是文学，我不会在最后突然透露任何有趣的启示。

sentences.en: I would just note that the default assumption is that the point of human life is to be as successful as possible, to acquire lots of fame or glory or money as defined by quantifiable
sentences.zh: 我只想指出，默认的假设是，人类生活的意义是尽可能成功，获得可量化定义的大量名誉、荣耀或金钱。

sentences.en: metrics: number of twitter followers, or facebook friends, or dollars in one's 401k which is a thing you guys don't know about yet, but it's coming.
sentences.zh: 指标：Twitter 关注者数量、Facebook 好友数量、401k 美元金额，这是你们还不知道的事情，但它即将到来。

sentences.en: That's the hero's journey, right? The hero starts out with no money and ends up with a lot of it.
sentences.zh: 这就是英雄之旅吧？英雄开始时身无分文，最终却拥有很多钱。

sentences.en: The hero starts out an ugly duckling and becomes a beautiful swan, or starts out an awwkard girl and becomes a vampire mother, or grows up an orphan living under the staircase and then becomes the wizard who saves the world.
sentences.zh: 主人公从丑小鸭变成美丽的天鹅，或者从笨拙的女孩变成吸血鬼母亲，或者从楼梯下长大的孤儿变成拯救世界的巫师。

sentences.en: We are taught that the hero's journey is the journey from weakness to strength.
sentences.zh: 我们被教导说，英雄的旅程是从软弱到坚强的旅程。

sentences.en: But I am here today to tell you that those stories are wrong.
sentences.zh: 但我今天在这里告诉你们这些故事是错误的。

sentences.en: The real hero's journey is the journey from strength to weakness.
sentences.zh: 真正的英雄之旅，是由强到弱的旅程。

sentences.en: And here is the good news nested inside the bad: Many of you, most of you, are about to make that journey.
sentences.zh: 这是隐藏在坏消息之中的好消息：你们中的许多人，大多数人，即将踏上这段旅程。

sentences.en: You will go from being the best-informed, most engaged students at one of the finest universities around to being, if you are lucky, the person who brings coffee to people, or
sentences.zh: 如果你幸运的话，你将从周围最好的大学之一最了解情况、最投入的学生变成为人们带来咖啡的人，或者

sentences.en: you might be a Steak n Shake waiter, as I once was.
sentences.zh: 你可能是牛排奶昔服务员，就像我曾经一样。

sentences.en: Whether you're a basketball player or a pharmacist or a software designer, you're about to be a rookie.
sentences.zh: 无论您是篮球运动员、药剂师还是软件设计师，您都将成为菜鸟。

sentences.en: Your parents' long-asked questions—what exactly does one DO with a degree in anthropology—will become a matter of sudden and profound relevance in your life.
sentences.zh: 你父母长期以来提出的问题——拥有人类学学位的人到底做什么——将突然成为你生活中的一个深刻而相关的问题。

sentences.en: Your student loans will come due and you will need a very good answer for why exactly you went to college in the first place, which answer you will have a hard time coming by
sentences.zh: 你的学生贷款即将到期，你需要一个很好的答案来解释你当初为什么上大学，而这个答案你将很难得到

sentences.en: as you sit at your job, provided you are lucky enough to find a job, and suffer the indignity of people calling you by the wrong name or, if you are forced to wear a name tag, people
sentences.zh: 当你坐在工作岗位上时，如果你足够幸运地找到了一份工作，并且会遭受人们用错误的名字称呼你的侮辱，或者，如果你被迫佩戴名牌，人们会侮辱你。

sentences.en: calling you by the right name too often.
sentences.zh: 过于频繁地叫你正确的名字。

sentences.en: That is the true hero's errand—the journey from strength to weakness.
sentences.zh: 这才是真正的英雄的使命——从强到弱的旅程。

sentences.en: And because you went to Butler, you will be more alive to the experience, better able to contextualize it and maybe even find the joy and wonder hidden amid the dehumanizing drudgery.
sentences.zh: 因为你去了巴特勒，你会对这种经历更加活跃，能够更好地将其置于情境中，甚至可能会发现隐藏在非人性苦差事中的快乐和惊奇。

sentences.en: For example, when I graduated from college I worked for awhile as a data entry professional, I would often call to mind William Faulkner's brilliant letter of resignation from the United States Postal Service, which went:
sentences.zh: 例如，当我大学毕业时，我曾担任过一段时间的数据录入专业人员，我经常会想起威廉·福克纳（William Faulkner）从美国邮政局发出的精彩辞职信，其中写道：

sentences.en: As long as I live under the capitalistic system, I expect to have my life influenced by the demands of moneyed people.
sentences.zh: 只要我生活在资本主义制度下，我就期望我的生活受到有钱人的需求的影响。

sentences.en: But I will be damned if I propose to be at the beck and call of every itinerant scoundrel who has two cents to invest in a postage stamp.
sentences.zh: 但如果我愿意听从每一个有两美分投资邮票的流动恶棍的指挥，那我就该死了。

sentences.en: This, sir, is my resignation. William Faulkner.
sentences.zh: 先生，这是我的辞职信。威廉·福克纳。

sentences.en: Having read that letter in a Faulkner biography in college had nothing to do with my job typing numbers into a database, but it was still profoundly useful to me.
sentences.zh: 在大学里读过福克纳传记中的这封信与我在数据库中输入数字的工作无关，但它对我来说仍然非常有用。

sentences.en: Education provides context and comfort and access, no matter the relationship between your field of study and the trajectory of your post-collegiate life.
sentences.zh: 无论你的学习领域和大学毕业后的生活轨迹之间的关系如何，教育都能提供背景、舒适感和机会。

sentences.en: But still, you are probably going to be a nobody for a while.
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此，你可能会在一段时间内成为无名小卒。

sentences.en: You are going to make that journey from strength to weakness, and while it won't be an easy trip, it is a heroic one.
sentences.zh: 你将经历从强到弱的旅程，虽然这不会是一次轻松的旅程，但却是一次英雄之旅。

sentences.en: For in learning how to be a nobody, you will learn how not to be a jerk.
sentences.zh: 因为在学习如何成为一个无名小卒的过程中，你将学会如何不成为一个混蛋。

sentences.en: And for the rest of your life, if you are able to remember your hero's journey from college grad to underling, you will be less of a jerk.
sentences.zh: 在你的余生中，如果你能够记住你的英雄从大学毕业生到下属的旅程，你就不会那么混蛋了。

sentences.en: You will tip well. You will empathize. You will be a mentor, and a generous one.
sentences.zh: 你会得到很好的小费。你会感同身受。你将成为一位导师，而且是一位慷慨的导师。

sentences.en: In short, you will become like the people you imagined in silence a few minutes ago.
sentences.zh: 总之，你会变得像几分钟前你默默想象的那样。

sentences.en: Let me submit to you that this is the actual definition of a good life.
sentences.zh: 让我告诉你，这就是美好生活的真正定义。

sentences.en: You want to be the kind of person who other people—people who may not even born yet—will think about in their own silences years from now at their own commencements.
sentences.zh: 你想成为其他人——甚至可能还没有出生的人——会在多年后的毕业典礼上默默地思考的人。

sentences.en: I am going to hazard a guess that relatively few of us closed our eyes and thought of all the work and love that Selena Gomez or Justin Bieber put into making this moment possible for us.
sentences.zh: 我大胆猜测，我们当中很少有人闭上眼睛，想到赛琳娜·戈麦斯或贾斯汀·比伯为让我们这一刻成为可能而付出的所有努力和爱。

sentences.en: We may be taught that the people to admire and emulate are actors and musicians and sports heroes and professionally famous people, but when we look at the people who have helped us, the people who actually change actual lives, relatively few of them are publicly
sentences.zh: 我们可能被教导说，值得钦佩和效仿的人是演员、音乐家、体育英雄和职业名人，但当我们看到那些帮助过我们的人、那些真正改变现实生活的人时，相对较少的人是公开的。

sentences.en: celebrated. We do not think of the money they had, but of their generosity.
sentences.zh: 庆祝。我们想到的不是他们有钱，而是他们的慷慨。

sentences.en: We do not think of how beautiful or powerful they were, but how willing they were to sacrifice for us—so willing, at times, that we might not have even noticed that they were making sacrifices.
sentences.zh: 我们不会想到他们有多么美丽或强大，而是他们多么愿意为我们做出牺牲——有时如此愿意，以至于我们甚至没有注意到他们正在做出牺牲。

sentences.en: So with that in mind, I'd like to share a few pieces of what I believe to be rock solid advice about proper adulthood: First and perhaps most importantly, do not worry too much about your lawn.
sentences.zh: 因此，考虑到这一点，我想分享一些我认为关于正确成年的坚如磐石的建议：首先，也许也是最重要的一点，不要太担心你的草坪。

sentences.en: You will soon find if you haven't already that almost every adult American devotes tremendous time and energy to the maintenance of an invasive plant species called turf grass that we can't
sentences.zh: 如果您还没有发现的话，您很快就会发现，几乎每个成年美国人都投入了大量的时间和精力来维护一种称为草坪草的入侵植物物种，而我们却无法做到这一点

sentences.en: eat. I think you should choose a better obsessions.
sentences.zh: 吃。我认为你应该选择一个更好的痴迷。

sentences.en: Also, you may have heard that it is better to burn out than it is to fade away.
sentences.zh: 另外，你可能听说过，精疲力尽比消失要好。

sentences.en: That is ridiculous. It is much better to fade away.
sentences.zh: 这太荒谬了。消失要好得多。

sentences.en: Always. Fade. Away. Keep reading. Specifically, read my books, ideally in hardcover.
sentences.zh: 总是。褪色。离开。继续阅读。具体来说，阅读我的书，最好是精装本。

sentences.en: But also keep reading other books. You have probably figured out by now that education is not really about grades or getting
sentences.zh: 但也要继续阅读其他书籍。您现在可能已经明白，教育实际上并不在于成绩或获得什么

sentences.en: a job; it's primarily about becoming a more aware and engaged observer of the universe.
sentences.zh: 一份工作；它主要是为了成为一个更有意识和更积极的宇宙观察者。

sentences.en: If that ends with college, you're rather wasting your one and only known chance at consciousness.
sentences.zh: 如果这一切在大学结束时，你就等于浪费了你唯一已知的获得意识的机会。

sentences.en: Also a word about the Internet: Old people like myself are terrified by their ignorance of the internet, and you should use that to your advantage.
sentences.zh: 还有关于互联网的一句话：像我这样的老年人对他们对互联网的无知感到恐惧，你应该利用这一点来发挥你的优势。

sentences.en: You should say things at your job like, "You don't have a tumblr?
sentences.zh: 你应该在工作中这样说：“你没有 tumblr？

sentences.en: Oh you should really have a tumblr. I can set you up with that."
sentences.zh: 哦，你真的应该有一个 tumblr。我可以给你安排一下。”

sentences.en: Try not to worry too much about what you are going to do with your life.
sentences.zh: 尽量不要过多担心你将要做什么。

sentences.en: You are already doing what you are going to do with your life, and judging by the fact that you are wearing a gown, you're doing pretty well.
sentences.zh: 你已经在做你一生要做的事情了，从你穿着礼服的事实来看，你做得很好。

sentences.en: That's not a sentence you hear much in life.
sentences.zh: 这不是你在生活中经常听到的一句话。

sentences.en: On that topic, there are many more jobs out there than you have ever heard of.
sentences.zh: 在这个话题上，有比你听说过的更多的工作。

sentences.en: In fact, your dream job might not yet exist.
sentences.zh: 事实上，您梦想的工作可能还不存在。

sentences.en: If you had told College Graduate Me that I would become a professional YouTuber, I would've been like, "That doesn't seem like a word."
sentences.zh: 如果你告诉大学毕业生我，我会成为一名专业的 YouTuber，我会说，“这看起来不像一个词。”

sentences.en: And lastly, I want to encourage you to be vigilant in the struggle toward empathy.
sentences.zh: 最后，我想鼓励你在争取同理心的斗争中保持警惕。

sentences.en: A couple years after I graduated from college, I was living in an apartment in Chicago with four friends, one of whom was this Kuwaiti guy, Hassan, and when the U.S. invaded Iraq, Hassan lost touch with his family, who lived on the border, for six weeks.
sentences.zh: 大学毕业几年后，我和四个朋友住在芝加哥的一间公寓里，其中一个是科威特人哈桑，当美国入侵伊拉克时，哈桑与住在边境的家人失去了六个星期的联系。

sentences.en: By the way, some of you have heard me tell this story before, but I have a microphone, you're seated and so you're going to listen to the rest of it.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，你们中的一些人以前听过我讲过这个故事，但我有麦克风，你们坐下来，所以你们要听剩下的故事。

sentences.en: So my friend Hassan responded to this stress by watching cable news coverage of the war 24 hours a day.
sentences.zh: 因此，我的朋友哈桑通过每天 24 小时观看有线电视新闻报道来应对这种压力。

sentences.en: And the only way to hang out with Hassan was to sit on the couch and watch the news with him.
sentences.zh: 和哈桑一起出去玩的唯一方法就是坐在沙发上和他一起看新闻。

sentences.en: So one day we were watching the news and the anchor was like, "We're getting new footage from the city of Baghdad," and a camera panned across a house that had a huge hole in one wall covered by a piece of plywood.
sentences.zh: 所以有一天，我们在看新闻时，主播说，“我们正在从巴格达市获得新的镜头”，然后一台摄像机扫过一栋房子，房子的一面墙上有一个大洞，上面覆盖着一块胶合板。

sentences.en: On the plywood was Arabic graffiti scrawled in black spraypaint, and as the news anchor talked about the anger on the Arab street, and Hassan started laughing for the first
sentences.zh: 胶合板上有用黑色喷漆潦草的阿拉伯涂鸦，当新闻主播谈到阿拉伯街上的愤怒时，哈桑第一次笑了起来

sentences.en: time in weeks. I said, "What's so funny?"
sentences.zh: 时间以周为单位。我说：“有什么好笑的？”

sentences.en: He said, "The graffiti." I said, "What's funny about it?"
sentences.zh: 他说：“涂鸦。”我说：“这有什么好笑的？”

sentences.en: He looked at me and he smiled and he said, "It says, Happy Birthday, Sir, Despite the Circumstances."
sentences.zh: 他看着我，微笑着说：“尽管如此，先生，生日快乐。”

sentences.en: For the rest of your life, you are going to have a choice about how to read graffiti in a language you do not know, and you will have a choice about how to read the actions and intonations of the people you meet.
sentences.zh: 在你的余生中，你将可以选择如何阅读你不知道的语言的涂鸦，你将可以选择如何阅读你遇到的人的动作和语调。

sentences.en: I would encourage you as often as possible to consider the Happy Birthday Sir Despite the Circumstances possibility, the possibility that the lives and experiences of others are
sentences.zh: 我会鼓励您尽可能多地考虑生日快乐先生，尽管有这种情况的可能性，其他人的生活和经历也可能是

sentences.en: as complex and unpredictable as your own.
sentences.zh: 就像你自己的一样复杂和不可预测。

sentences.en: That other people—be they family or strangers, near or far—are not simply one thing or the other—not simply good or evil or wise or ignorant—but that they like you contain
sentences.zh: 其他人，无论是家人还是陌生人，无论远近，都不仅仅是一件事或另一件事，不仅仅是善或恶，明智或无知，而是他们像你一样包含着

sentences.en: multitudes, to borrow a phrase from the great Walt Whitman.
sentences.zh: 借用伟大的沃尔特·惠特曼的一句话。

sentences.en: This is difficult to do—it is difficult to remember that people with lives different and distant from your own even celebrate birthdays, let alone with gifts of graffitied plywood.
sentences.zh: 这很难做到——很难记住那些与你生活不同、相距甚远的人甚至会庆祝生日，更不用说带着涂鸦胶合板的礼物了。

sentences.en: You will always be stuck inside of your body, with your consciousness, seeing through the world through your own eyes, but the gift and challenge of your Butler education is to see others as they see themselves, to grapple meaningfully with this cruel and crazy and
sentences.zh: 你将永远被困在你的身体里，用你的意识，通过你自己的眼睛看世界，但你的巴特勒教育的礼物和挑战是看到别人看到他们自己，有意义地应对这种残酷、疯狂和

sentences.en: beautiful world in all its baffling complexity.
sentences.zh: 美丽的世界充满了令人困惑的复杂性。

sentences.en: I know that we have not left you with the easiest path, and I'm sorry, but I have every confidence in you, and I wish you a very happy graduation, despite the circumstances.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们没有给你留下最简单的道路，我很抱歉，但我对你充满信心，无论情况如何，我祝你毕业快乐。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。
